tools.name: search
tools.description: Find documentation pages about a subject. Returns an id, a title, a URL and a matching line for each hit, best first. Pass the id to `fetch` to read the page.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read one documentation page in full, as markdown. The id is what `search` returns, which is the page's path without /docs/ - for example `authentication` or `api/pages`.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
